    README.md

    repo_master

    The index of every repository this account owns. 79 repositories (60 🌐 public, 19 🔒 private) in 8 areas, 26 projects, 47 families and 13 hubs. 0_registry/clone.sh pulls down whichever ones you want on this machine. This repo is the index, so the registry has no entry pointing at itself.

    One master file, everything rendered

    Edit 0_registry/projects-repos.json only, then run node 0_registry/gen-registry.js. It is the ONE master source, validated by projects-repos.schema.json: the whole hierarchy (areas, projects, families, repos, with codes, labels, descriptions, icons, banners, hubs, farm folders, visibility, developer, renames, consumers) AND each public repo's folder tree (tree, depth folders.max_depth; private repos carry none). Every file below is rendered from it by the one generator 0_registry/gen-registry.js and never edited by hand. Its hierarchy is AREA -> PROJECT -> (SUB-CATEGORY) -> FAMILY -> REPO with positional codes (area N, project N.M, family N.M.F, repo N.M.F.R); a node's hub repo has the code <node>.0. A repo's farm folder, hub, developer, URLs and visibility flag are derived from its place in the tree, never stored twice.

The .md/.html copies carry a "generated by build.sh" comment; the .json, .xml and .canvas copies cannot (no comment syntax we may add), so this line is their notice.     Layout

    The committed symlinks sit in one folder per area or project, named <code>.<Name> after its node; sub-folders follow the hub chain, plus the Fin split Corporate / Capital-Markets. Each link is <farm>/<name> -> ../ per level + name, pointing out to the one clone in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/cloud-shared-store/git). A link that dangles is a repo you have not cloned yet: that is the index working. No project code lives here.

    Per-repo README.html and README.canvas (A2_repo-readmes/)

    Every non-archived repo of the registry carries two generated files at its root next to README.md: README.html (self-contained: inline CSS, no script, no network at view time; GitHub-like page in the fleet's dark monospace style) and README.canvas (JSON Canvas 1.0, the Obsidian format: project and family groups, one node per repo with its role, hub-to-member edges, this repo highlighted in yellow, link nodes to GitHub, Pages and the domain page). Raw URL pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegonmarcos/<repo>/main/README.canvas (and README.html).

    • Engine: ./build.sh runs node 0_registry/render-repo-readmes.js (Markdown via 0_registry/md-lite.js, node built-ins only). Inputs: projects-repos.json, the GitHub cache A0_repos-tree/src/gh-meta.json, A2_repo-readmes/src/ and, per repo, the committed HEAD of its local clone under $BASE (root file tree, README.md, LICENSE, language bar). No clone: registry data only plus a "no local clone at render time" note. Output is deterministic (no clock, no HEAD sha).
    • Deploy: sh A2_repo-readmes/deploy-readmes.sh copies dist/<repo>/ to each clone root (README.html gets a "generated by" comment after the doctype, the canvas is a byte copy), commits only those two files (sparse clones: --sparse), pulls --no-rebase and pushes origin main. NO_PUSH=1 commits only; --check changes nothing and exits 1 on drift. Held (never pushed, commit only): cloudy-t-infra, cloudy-u-containers; never deployed: the profile repo diegonmarcos and diegonmarcos.github.io. README.md is never touched.
    • Tests: 9_others/test/test-repo-readmes.sh.

    Clone depth

    0_registry/clone.sh clones with --depth 1 --shallow-submodules by default: only the latest commit, so a clone is fast and takes little disk. Each repo has exactly ONE clone (in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE); the links point at it, so never keep a second full copy next to it.

    0_registry/clone.sh <name>...                 # shallow, depth 1 (default)
0_registry/clone.sh --full <name>...          # full history (same as CLONE_DEPTH=0)
CLONE_DEPTH=50 0_registry/clone.sh <name>...  # a deeper shallow clone
git -C <clone> fetch --unshallow     # later, turn an existing clone into full history
git -C <clone> submodule update --init --depth 1   # submodules stay shallow too

    Hubs

    Every repo except this one carries its hub as a git submodule at 0_hub/<hub> (a hub carries its parent hub); hubs keep symlinks to their members and a repos.json subset checked by node 0_registry/repos-sot.js check-hub-subsets. Their clone.sh is rendered from 9_others/templates/hub-clone.sh (node 0_registry/repos-sot.js sync-hub-scripts). A public repo never gets a private hub.

    Git attributes (.gitattributes_ours)

    This repo is plain metadata, so it carries no in-tree .gitattributes: sync clients such as GitSync (Android) treat any attributes/filters as a premium feature. The rules live in .gitattributes_ours (source: _dotfiles/git/src/gitattributes) and are applied locally by 9_others/build.sh, which sets git config --local core.attributesFile "$PWD/.gitattributes_ours". On a fresh clone, run that one command (or 9_others/build.sh) to get LF normalisation, union-merge logs and binary handling.
